notes.title: Continued Development
notes.content:
Hello all and my deepest apologies for the missed release date and long silence!

We began working on a new project mid development (I know, I know. Bad dev) which ended up recieving significantly more traction. 

The project is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2370420/Chronomon/]Chronomon[/url]

Chronomon still has about 8 months of development time left + hot fixes that will take even longer. So in the meantime, I will be taking the next week on Dungeon Dash to get it into a playable state and releasing it as [b]FREE[/b]. 

That's right free. I don't see the point in leaving it hanging for so long TBH. 

DD is currently playable with quite a few levels and features but it is not something we feel comfortable making you pay for. If it becomes popular, we have plans to release a 1 time DLC that adds the rest of the game. 

Anyways, thank you for following and being so freaking patient. I will push another broadcast out when we get closer to announce the release date.
